entries.root_cause: The G11 authority provider stored only scopes per token and ignored the tenant_id argument; any valid token could access any tenant's incidents or mutate any policy by inserting the target tenant in the path and X-Tenant-Id header. A machine credential must resolve and enforce its authorized tenant set, rejecting requests for tenants not explicitly bound to that credential.
horizontal_audit: tenant_id argument ignored in scope lookup
cross-tenant incident read and policy write
G11_MACHINE_TOKEN_MAP env var format and validation

entries.root_cause: After removing the break from the notify-channel loop, multiple matching channels produced multiple identical generic 'notify' action requests. Because g11_enqueue_action stored only the action kind, g11_next_pending_action returned no channel configuration to the worker, preventing adapters from routing the notification to the correct destination. Each notify action must carry the matched channel configuration as a payload so the worker can dispatch each notification independently.
horizontal_audit: worker adapter channel routing from candidate payload
multi-channel notify completeness per matching severity

entries.root_cause: The _render_ui function used e.get('severity_hint', '—') as the default, but when PostgreSQL stores a null value the field is returned as JSON null and e.get returns None rather than the absent-key default. Passing None to html.escape raised AttributeError, crashing the entire UI request for any event list containing an unhinted event. Nullable values from storage must be coerced to a safe non-null representation before any transformation is applied.
horizontal_audit: G11 UI rendering of nullable severity_hint
e.get default sentinel versus JSON null from storage
GET handler exception handling for UI endpoint
nullable-to-string coercion before escaping at render boundary
